title: Playboy January 1988 Holiday Anniversary Issue Complete w/ Centerfold Art Deco
conditionDescription: Covers bright with no tears; spine intact. A few small white scuff marks on the dark front cover (lower right and right edge) and light edge wear. Complete with centerfold. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, January 1988 - Holiday Anniversary Issue, original $4.00 cover price. Complete with centerfold.

Cover: art deco illustration of a glittering Rabbit Head skyline with tuxedoed revelers.

Back cover: Miller Genuine Draft ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
